scope: All unlabeled ordinary trees of order 14 at fixed p=6 (first-order shell n=2p+2), subject to x+2<=p and 3p<2alpha+1.
constraints_verified_by_source_instrumen: all distinct favorable leaf tags included in complete S

finite_lp.variables: lambda_t for each eligible tree class t in the records array
finite_lp.dual: y=-222 for the single equality sum_t lambda_t=1; constraints y>=S_t hold for every listed column. A column attaining -222 proves optimality.
finite_lp.interpretation: Convex mixtures of realizable eligible order-14 trees only; not a relaxation over all p or all shell orders.
